title: Add a function, then change it in a follow-up message of the same session
prompts: Can you add a slugify(title) function to src/text.ts? Lowercase, words joined with single hyphens, so "Hello World" becomes "hello-world".

Thanks. One more thing about the slugs: they also need to drop accents and anything that isn't a letter or a digit, so "Crème Brûlée!" becomes "creme-brulee", and there should never be a hyphen at the start or end.
